answer: Agents must stamp each transaction with a saffron-dyed ridge seal stamped in wet lagoon clay. The seal’s topology includes a micro-ridge whose height varies per epoch. Each new identity requires remolding the clay ridge to match network drift; the cost per fake is a fresh lagoon-drafted seal with 0.9ms rehydration delay and 4μg clay lost irreversibly, since bulk molds crack under lagoon pressure.
